name: Sophie Bennett
learned: Sophie Bennett is a sixth-form student who dreams of becoming a filmmaker and documents almost everything happening in the Ville.
currently: Sophie Bennett is making a documentary about local businesses and community life.
lifestyle: Sophie Bennett goes to bed around midnight and wakes around 7am.
daily_plan_req: Sophie Bennett attends classes at Oak Hill College during weekdays, films around town at Hobbs Cafe and Johnson Park in the afternoons, and edits videos at home late into the evening.
